subject.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges

question: Should `chunkTextRanges` become a supported public plugin SDK contract with the semantics encoded by this patch?
rationale: The implementation is focused and well-covered, but adding a plugin SDK function and types creates a long-lived compatibility commitment that requires owner intent rather than automated acceptance.

options.title: Approve the SDK contract
options.body: Accept the current range semantics and land after refreshing against main and confirming exact-head SDK and Zalouser checks.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Rework or close the PR if maintainers do not want these semantics exposed as a supported external plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current range semantics and land after refreshing against main and confirming exact-head SDK and Zalouser checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is self-assigned, described as maintainer-requested, and this owner authored the proposed shared contract and validation.
